Gap-closure rounds MUST NOT mint new members or edit these vectors to re-score:
the whole signature proof is that this exact table is observed RED with no
evaluator in existence and green at the end of the phase, with nothing added in
expectedGates is what a CORRECT evaluator must report for the draft. `measured` is
what the live lane actually observed on 2026-08-10 (plan 393-01 Task 2), read from
the durable run record .agent-qa/runs/<runId>/handoff.json — tests[].outcome and
Per D-17: definitive = a final pass or fail; planning failure, infeasible
termination, cycle-flag, error, timeout and cancelled are gate-1 fails. A healed
pass counts as pass, and the heal is recorded.
coveredElementsInThatSuite: Username field (type), Password field (type), Account name field (type), Submit button (click), "Received!" page text (assert). The only local-form surface NOT covered by it is the h1 "Local Form" heading and the "Back to the form" link on received.html — which is what the novel-element column below turns on (D-14).

assertion-free.yaml.rationale: Fails D-09 clause (i): no step classifies as an assertion at all. Gate 4 is the only catcher — the draft executes, is stable, and clicks the "Back to the form" link, which no seeded local-form test anchors.

page-loaded-only.yaml.rationale: D-04's INDEPENDENCE EXEMPLAR: executes, stable, adds value, but its single assertion is vacuous (D-09 clause (ii) vacuity lexicon). Gate 4 must be demonstrably the only catcher, which is why this draft carries the novel "Back to the form" anchor — without it gate 3 would fire too and the exemplar would prove nothing.

runs.note: LANE FLAKE, not a draft property: 'LLM planning failed: Guardrail blocked outbound prompt leaf: creditCard' on step 0. A planning failure is a D-17 indefinitive class, so this run would read gate 1 false. Did not reproduce.

measured.executionColumnsFrom: measured (3 runs, 2/3 definitive pass). The expected vector records the draft's property; the 1/3 guardrail flake is disclosed so a later plan does not mistake it for a gate signal.

oracle-capture-signature.yaml.rationale: D-10 capture signature: the expected value is a 32-char lowercase hex literal, the shape of machine-generated content. executesDefinitive is false and INTRINSICALLY so — a value that only a capture could have produced is never present on a fresh run, so this draft can never reach a definitive verdict. Gates 1 and 4 both fire; gate 4 is the class it is the exemplar for.

runs.reason: The required submission reference is absent from the complete received page.

oracle-capture-tautology.yaml.rationale: D-10 tautology: the assertion restates the content of a prior action step rather than an independent outcome. The execution columns are FALSE BY MEASUREMENT, and the cause is an artifact rather than a semantic property — see measured.contamination. They are recorded as measured anyway, because writing the intuited vector here is exactly the Pitfall-6 failure this table exists to prevent.

runs.reason: The Username field visibly contains "probe-user", not "alice".

runs.note: --disable-cache does NOT suppress the contamination — it is knowledge-store procedure replay, not the action cache.

measured.contamination: The seeded local-form PROCEDURE in the demo knowledge store replays the local-form test's own values: the agent fills "probe-user" into the Username field, self-heals to the draft's literal, and whether the correction lands before the tautology assertion reads the field is a race. Measured 1/2 healed, 1/2 infeasible on the current 2-step shape. Dropping the Password step removed one replay trigger but not the race. A later plan that wants these execution columns to read true must neutralize procedure replay for gate-runs; --disable-cache is PROVEN INEFFECTIVE for it.

gate1-indefinitive.yaml.rationale: References controls the target does not have (a Reports panel, an Export report button), so the run cannot reach a definitive verdict. Stable because all three runs agreed; adds value because those anchors are entirely uncovered; the assertion quotes a concrete literal, so gate 4 passes. Gate 1 is the only catcher.

measured.criticalFinding: The D-17 indefinitive signal is NOT readable from the member-outcome enum. MemberTestOutcome is 'failed' — a DEFINITIVE value — while StepEvidence.termination.kind is 'infeasible', an indefinitive class. A gate 1 implemented over the member outcome alone PASSES this draft and the corpus proves nothing. Gate 1 must read step-level termination.

gate2-unstable.yaml.rationale: Asserts the alternating surface, so consecutive runs disagree by construction. executesDefinitive is false because the mismatch arm surfaces as an infeasible termination (see the cross-cutting finding), not because the draft is unreachable.

measured.reproducibility: 3/3 runs matched the schedule's prediction, including the return to baseline on run 3 — a schedule, not a coincidence
measured.conditionOnTheVector: THIS VECTOR IS CONDITIONED ON THE PER-REQUEST SERVER. Under the baseline server this draft passes every run and stableVerdict reads TRUE. Any later plan must start the server with --mutate-per-request for this cell and with no flag for every other cell.
measured.supersededAssumption: Research A2 assumed one /form.html fetch per run. Measured: exactly two, ~300ms apart. At REQUESTS_PER_VARIANT=1 both variants landed inside a single run, the agent's second fetch decided every verdict, and two consecutive runs failed identically — no flip at all.

runs.note: PITFALL 7, LIVE: the accept control's definitive pass arrives as 'healed', not 'passed'. Gate 1 must count a healed pass as a pass and record the heal, or the corpus's own accept control fails the gates it is meant to pass.

crossCuttingFindings.title: 'infeasible' termination does not separate gate 1 from gate 2 on this build
crossCuttingFindings.detail: Both 'the element does not exist' (gate1-indefinitive) and 'the assertion is false on a visible page' (gate2-unstable's mutated arm, oracle-capture-signature) surface as StepEvidence.termination.kind === 'infeasible' with verifierVerdict.pass === false and member outcome 'failed'. A survey of the demo run store found 19 of 21 failed members carry an infeasible termination and only 2 are clean definitive failures. Gate 1 therefore cannot be implemented as 'no step terminated infeasible' without also failing gate2-unstable's mutated arm, and cannot be implemented over the member-outcome enum alone without passing gate1-indefinitive. Recorded, not resolved — resolving it is the gate implementation's job.

crossCuttingFindings.title: Seeded procedure replay contaminates draft execution on this target
crossCuttingFindings.detail: Because the corpus drafts are near-identical flows to the seeded local-form test, the agent replays that procedure and fills the local-form test's own values ('probe-user') into the Username field, then self-heals to the draft's literal. Every multi-step draft measured shows heals from this. It is why 5 of 8 drafts return 'healed' rather than 'passed', and it is fatal to oracle-capture-tautology's execution columns. --disable-cache is proven ineffective.

crossCuttingFindings.title: The definitive-pass arm arrives as 'healed', not 'passed'
crossCuttingFindings.detail: Measured on the accept control itself. D-17 already rules that a healed pass counts as a pass with the heal recorded (Pitfall 7); this table is the live confirmation that the rule is load-bearing rather than theoretical.
